name: [❄️] Pull Brainrots
desc:
🕹️Welcome to Pull Brainrots!

❓ How to Play:

🎯Dive into the cave and use the Claw Machine to pull Brainrots!

🔥Collect Brainrots with different rarities and wild mutations!

💸Your Brainrots generate money over time!

⚙️Upgrade your equipment to pull stronger, rarer, and more chaotic Brainrots!

Build the ultimate Brainrot collection and flex your pulls!


👍Like the game & join the group for updates!

📱Playable on PC, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
